{{Quote|Vastin is very protective, and whatever the spoiled brat wants, his daddy gets for him.|Rivoche Tarkin|<ref name="Small Favors">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>}}
'''Vastin Caglio''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the eldest son of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jamson Caglio]] of the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]]. He was engaged to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] [[Rivoche Tarkin]], niece of the late [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
